nodes.title: WF-05 — H3 latent-mask editing
widgets_values:
Four independent examples. Only Inpainting is enabled. Mute its group before enabling another group (Never mode, not Bypass). Upload your source video and, for spatial edits, a black/white mask. Set the Generate Video URL and model to your EDIT-01-enabled server. Black = preserve; white = regenerate. Preservation is in latent space, not lossless pixel copying.

All examples: 24 FPS, 1344 x 768. Source clip: 107 frames at 24 FPS. Inpainting/removal/continuation output 107 frames; extension outputs 209. Save Video retains returned audio. See docs/wf05-h3-latent-editing.md for prerequisites and validation status.
Replace the masked region with a vase of sunflowers. Keep the rest of the scene and camera motion consistent.
nodes.title: Inpainting
Inpainting guide
widgets_values: Upload a black/white RGB mask using the red channel. White covers the region to replace. The same mask applies to every frame; cover the full motion path or use a tracked mask batch instead. Use a source with audio: audio_mask=0 preserves its audio latents. For silent sources set audio_mask=1 to generate an audio track.
Remove the object inside the masked region. Reconstruct the background naturally and maintain consistent camera motion.
nodes.title: Object removal
Object removal guide
widgets_values: Upload a black/white RGB mask using the red channel. White covers the region to remove. The same mask applies to every frame; cover the full motion path or use a tracked mask batch instead. Use a source with audio: audio_mask=0 preserves its audio latents. For silent sources set audio_mask=1 to generate an audio track.
Continue the opening action into a new ending. Maintain the same subject, setting and camera motion, with natural synchronized sound.
nodes.title: Continuation
Continuation guide
widgets_values: Regenerate the ending within a 107-frame output: 32 latent time slices, first 16 preserved and last 16 regenerated. This is a latent-time boundary, not a frame-exact splice. Audio mask=1 regenerates the entire soundtrack. EDIT-02 only exposes a scalar audio mask, so this example does not preserve a prefix of the original audio.
Extend the shot beyond the original ending. Continue the motion smoothly with consistent appearance and natural synchronized sound.
nodes.title: Extension
Extension guide
widgets_values: Extend a 107-frame source to 209 frames: source has 32 latent time slices; output has 62. Preserve the first 32 and regenerate the remaining 30. EDIT-01 pads the short source using its last frame before encoding. Use a 107-frame source at 24 FPS; other lengths require adjusting both mask counts and output duration. Audio mask=1 regenerates the entire soundtrack. EDIT-02 only exposes a scalar audio mask, so this example does not preserve a prefix of the original audio.
